exposure: iatrogenic injuries (gynecological surgery, post radiation therapy)
cohort: The study included patients undergoing surgical repair for various genitourinary fistulae at a tertiary care institute in India from 2016 to 2022.
finding: The primary causes of genitourinary fistulae have shifted from obstructed prolonged labor to iatrogenic injuries (gynecological surgeries) and carcinoma cervix in India.
mod_finding: Enhanced healthcare services have led to a decrease in obstructed prolonged labor, consequently reducing related genitourinary fistula injuries.
